pass.answer: **Re-execution (HIGH).** Started again while a slow run is still uploading, both runs list the same PDFs and expenses.csv gets two rows per receipt. Stopped between its writes, a run that appended the row but never moved the PDF to done/ leaves it in inbox/, so the next run adds it again. Mitigation: open every run with a reconciliation step: read the receipt ids already in expenses.csv and the files already in done/ and on the drive, and act only on what is missing (append a row only for an id not in the CSV, upload only a file absent from the drive).
pass.why: second run, a named half-finished state, and a reconciliation step with concrete techniques
